module_summary: Clock divider producing /2, /10 and /100 clocks: a toggle flop and two terminal-count counters that toggle their output clocks.

anchors.name: CLK_50
anchors.why: Divide-by-2 output clock, toggled every input clock edge.

anchors.name: CLK_10
anchors.why: Divide-by-10 output clock, toggled when cnt_10 reaches terminal count.

anchors.name: CLK_1
anchors.why: Divide-by-100 output clock, toggled when cnt_100 reaches terminal count.

anchors.name: cnt_10
anchors.why: Counts 0..4 then wraps, triggering CLK_10 toggle.

anchors.name: cnt_100
anchors.why: Counts 0..49 then wraps, triggering CLK_1 toggle.

groups.name: div2
groups.description: Toggle flop dividing input clock by two.
